per_row_disposition.W1301-DRIVER-RAN: meta row, not a source behaviour: its negation is 'node declined to launch', measured by forcing resolve_node to return no binary, which produced FAIL with 26 named failures rather than a silent pass (reviewer round 3, what_i_ran item 10)
per_row_disposition.W1301-TOOLCHAIN-NODE-FROM-LOCKED-TABLE: OWED, with a second demonstrated blind spot: mutants I1 and I2 replaced the two verification conditions in resolve_node (the sha256 comparison, and the returncode/version comparison) with False, and the run stayed PASS with all 31 assertions and the driver alive both times. So the row reports that a table was consulted, not that verification gates the launch - it would still pass if hash and version checking were both removed. Together with H4 (a PATH fallback at the call site, also unnoticed) this is the strongest coverage finding on the card and belongs to whoever next owns tests/ui/check, since the file is pinned by an accepted receipt
